plan.acceptance: Every original ratio-of-medians CPU/wall comparison AND every simultaneous upper percentile block-bootstrap bound on mean CPU/wall ratios must be <=5%. All complete results retained. No automatic retry.
plan.cpu_selection: Rank physical CPU pairs by minimum sibling idle fraction over five seconds; assign disjoint pairs before sampling, keep every arm of each case on its assigned CPU. Coordinator and inference exclude all assigned pairs.
plan.execution: Shared independent case workers on disjoint physical CPU pairs; no owned builds/tests/corpus during sampling.

limitations: Only stable Rust 1.93.0/1.93.1 x86-64 little-endian ELF and the exact verified Display forwarding body qualify.
Both live string words must be complete, aligned and tied to the original formatting call. Valid UTF-8 follows the original Formatter::pad contract.
Unchanged macro expressions execute with explicit input bindings; no complete-body recompilation or original panic-location equivalence is claimed.
Custom and derived callbacks, unknown wrappers, older layouts, aggregate types and full Go/Rust parity remain separate work.
